message: The generated artifact must retain the Phase 3 identifier.
Feature extraction must produce exactly one output row per input row.
A changed identifier order would corrupt later joins.
Existing duplicate identifiers are reported but do not alter row-local feature computation.
At least one numeric feature column is required.
Only the identifier may be non-feature metadata.
NaN values would make the saved numeric artifact unreliable.
Infinite values are not valid row-level features.
